name: Third Amendment Annexure items in force after ninety days (r. 1(3)(b))

attrs.quote: the amendments listed in Annexure, which shall come into force after ninety days
attrs.scope: the Annexure: regulation 23(1)(c) (appeal), the opening of regulation 25 (corroboration with AI-detected senders) and the proviso to regulation 25(4)(d)(ii)
attrs.note: window is computed: 90 days after publication in the Official Gazette, dated 18 September 2026.
